name: Darkening of the Light
theme: Darkening of the Light buries radiance beneath the earth. The light is not gone; it is being protected from conditions that cannot honor it.
basicInterpretation: Keep your clarity inward if the outer world is unsafe or unreceptive. There are times when concealment is care, not cowardice.

reversed.theme: Turned around, Darkening of the Light becomes Hexagram 35, Progress. This other side brings in the atmosphere of advancement, visibility, growth, asking how the situation may look from another threshold.
reversed.reflection: Let Progress widen the reading rather than replace it. Consider what another person, timing, or hidden part of you might see when the pattern is viewed from the far side.

opposite.theme: The contrast to Darkening of the Light is Hexagram 6, Conflict. Where the primary pattern emphasizes hidden light, wounding, caution, this complementary field points toward dispute, tension, restraint.
opposite.reflection: This is not the main movement of the reading, but it shows what balances or challenges it. Notice where Conflict names the medicine, shadow, or unchosen path beside the situation.
